summary:
Frontend-only testing of the two new rules for company 9930867220 (Demo, gyanindramishra@gmail.com). Verified: (1) free-10-then-₹49 unlock quota end-to-end in the All Crew tab — first button read 'Unlock free · 10 left', unlocking showed toast 'CV unlocked — free!', card Name/Mobile/Email revealed, and the other cards' labels decremented 9→1 across 10 real UI unlocks; the 11th button flipped to 'Unlock full CV · ₹49' and its toast was 'CV unlocked! (₹49 paid — demo)'. (2) WhatsApp prefilled template on unlocked cards — intercepted window.open: 'Hi Rajesh Nair, we found your profile on Smart Crewing for a Chief Engineer position.
Can you share your CV on my email ID (gyanindramishra@gmail.com) or here on WhatsApp?
Regards
Demo ' — email + company name come from the logged-in company's own requirement. (3) Saved Searches parity — result unlock button showed 'Unlock CV · ₹49' after quota exhaustion, unlock worked, and result-wa-<id> produced the identical template. (4) Regression — match-alerts row, '2 new matches since your last visit' banner, green match-reasons tags and provider match grid all render. Backend intentionally not retested.

ui_bugs.issue: 'CVs Unlocked' stat stayed at 0 through 11 unlocks in the same session; only correct (11) after a page reload. Stat cards are not refreshed after unlock actions.
Paid toast reads 'CV unlocked! (₹49 — demo)' while Matches.jsx (and the spec) uses 'CV unlocked! (₹49 paid — demo)'. Also label copy differs: 'Unlock CV · ₹49' vs 'Unlock full CV · ₹49'.
Company name is stored with a trailing space ('Demo '), so the WhatsApp message ends 'Regards\nDemo ' (trailing whitespace). Suggest trimming companyEmail/companyName in buildContactMessage.

action_items: Align SavedSearches paid toast text with Matches: 'CV unlocked! (₹49 paid — demo)' and label 'Unlock full CV · ₹49'.
Refresh Dashboard overview stats (CVs Unlocked / Payments) after an unlock, or expose a lightweight refetch.
Trim companyName/companyEmail in buildContactMessage so the message doesn't end with stray whitespace.
critical_code_review_comments: waLink is redefined locally in both Matches.jsx and SavedSearches.jsx even though src/lib/waMessage.js exports it — DRY violation, import the shared helper.
SavedSearches initialises freeLeft=0, so if /saved-searches/{id}/results ever fails the label silently falls back to '₹49' — prefer null + disabled state.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed (3 low-severity copy/stale-stat nits)

seed_data_creation: Consumed the company's 10 free unlocks plus 2 paid (₹49) unlocks on 9930867220 — unlocks now 12. Reset db.unlocks for user 42a54995-f739-4493-90e2-5b097c5a26ef to re-demo the free quota. Helper: /app/tests/check_state.py prints user/provider/unlock counts.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login recipe still valid: select_option('IN') on [data-testid=login-phone] select, then press_sequentially digits into login-phone-number. Free quota for 9930867220 is now EXHAUSTED (12 unlocks) — reset db.unlocks before re-testing the free-label path. window.open interception works for reading wa.me URLs.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — both new rules behave as specified in the UI. Remaining findings are copy inconsistency in SavedSearches toast/label, stale dashboard stat cards (data loaded once on mount), and a trailing space in the stored company_name leaking into the WhatsApp message.
